import copy,json
from pathlib import Path
import work
policy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())
requests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())
report=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())
assert report == [work.evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]
probes=[({'declared':['tracked'],'saved':{'tracked':{'kind':'missing'},'extra':1},'current':{'extra':2}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'z'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']}),({'declared':['kept','ignored'],'saved':{'kept':{'kind':'file','data':{'b':2,'a':1}},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'kept':{'data':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]
for request,p,expected in probes:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(p))
 assert work.evaluate(request,p)==expected
 assert (request,p)==before
print('final verification passed')
